o: a colonial tax on dwellings that pushed Nigerians into wage labour or cash crop farming
the British administrator who championed indirect rule and merged the protectorates in 1914
colonial government through officials of the colonial power rather than through traditional rulers
the joining of the Northern and Southern Protectorates into one colony of Nigeria
items.s: Direct rule: colonial government through officials of the colonial power rather than through traditional rulers. The other options describe Hut tax, Lugard, Amalgamation of 1914.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Secular state.
o: indigenous African religious systems which include belief in a Supreme Being and veneration of ancestors
a state that adopts no official religion and treats all faiths equally
a faith established in the south through missionary activity and now practised across the country
the willingness to let people of other faiths practise their beliefs peacefully
items.s: Secular state: a state that adopts no official religion and treats all faiths equally. The other options describe Christianity in Nigeria, Religious tolerance, African Traditional Religion.

items.q: “the process by which an individual learns the norms and values of a society” is the definition of
o: Culture
Norm
Socialisation
Ethnocentrism
items.s: Socialisation is the process by which an individual learns the norms and values of a society.

items.q: Three of these relate to Contemporary issues and citizenship. Which one does not?
o: Citizenship
Rule of law
Citizenship by registration
Citizenship by birth
items.s: Every other option belongs to Contemporary issues and citizenship. “Rule of law” belongs to Constitution, federalism and governance, not Contemporary issues and citizenship.

items.q: The correct meaning of Age grade is
o: a nineteenth-century Islamic state established through the jihad of Usman dan Fodio
an early Igbo ritual centre whose influence spread through its religious authority rather than conquest
an association of people of similar age that performs community service and social control
a society without a centralised ruler, governed by lineage heads, councils and age grades
items.s: Age grade: an association of people of similar age that performs community service and social control. The other options describe Nri, Sokoto Caliphate, Acephalous society.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Culture.
o: the intangible parts of culture such as beliefs, values, language and customs
the total way of life of a people, including beliefs, values, norms and material objects
an accepted standard of behaviour in a society
a shared belief about what is desirable and worth pursuing
items.s: Culture: the total way of life of a people, including beliefs, values, norms and material objects. The other options describe Non-material culture, Norm, Value.
